prompt: A red fox trots through fresh snow in a sunlit pine forest, its breath steaming in the cold air. The camera tracks alongside it at ground level. Snow crunches under its paws and birds sing in the distance.

The red fox keeps trotting through the fresh snow between the pine trees, then slows down and stops at the edge of the forest, lifting its head to sniff the cold air. The camera keeps tracking alongside it at ground level in the bright winter sun, and between the last trunks a wide frozen lake glitters in the distance. Snow crunches under its paws and a light wind blows through the pines.

A black raven perches on a snow-covered pine branch above a frozen lake, turning its head to watch something below. It ruffles its feathers, caws twice and takes off, shaking snow from the branch. Close-up shot with a shallow depth of field in bright winter sunlight. Its caws echo across the silent lake.

The red fox stands still at the edge of the pine forest, its ears pricked toward the cawing of a raven. It sniffs the air, then walks out of the trees and trots away from the camera toward the wide frozen lake, leaving small paw prints in the fresh snow. The camera stays low behind it in the bright winter sun. Snow crunches under its paws and the wind whistles over the ice.
